old_problem: The source intends AMP_PDB_HSC, AMP_INTB_0 and AMP_INTB_1, but its shell-like `grep ... and ...0~1` neither expresses a reliable conjunction nor expands a range. Electrical source/channel/load ownership, scaling and limits are absent, and criteria jump from 2 to 44.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by preserving all three literal identities and replacing ambiguous selection syntax with separate exact matching after full inventory capture. ED-03 makes the PDB/HSC/INTB path map and load state Project Configuration, ED-13 governs any unpopulated member, ED-15 requires approved current limits, and ED-19 forbids collapsing the members. The test stays passive and never probes live current paths.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2027, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2028 / Wistron-HW-00483-V002 / 465c39de1bd9b963.
The exact target set is recoverable from source text: AMP_PDB_HSC, AMP_INTB_0 and AMP_INTB_1. Each must be evidenced separately; no invented aggregate is allowed.
Each current record is bound to board/controller, source feed, measurement channel and protected load, with amperes/milliamperes scaling and load-dependent limits from the approved specification.
Complete IB/OOB lists and three Web mappings prove reporting parity. Calibrated accuracy, if required, needs a separate approved procedure and is not inferred from shared telemetry.
Criteria 1, 2 and 44 are retained without creating criteria 3-43.
No ipmitool, power/current query, live probe, authentication, Web capture, load/power/threshold change, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Three-path PDB-HSC and INTB0/INTB1 current-sensor reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify AMP_PDB_HSC, AMP_INTB_0 and AMP_INTB_1 independently against their source/channel/load paths and reconcile scaled current, state, thresholds and freshness across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web under documented load.
required_package: SUT/BMC/PDB/HSC/INTB board and controller revisions with power-path topology
Exact source/channel/protected-load map for the three named AMP records
Versioned units/scaling, load-dependent range/tolerance/threshold/state/freshness and N/A rules plus five-view crosswalk
Documented power/load/redundancy context, approved ipmitool and protected OOB/Web access
Power/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; create three explicit rows for AMP_PDB_HSC, AMP_INTB_0 and AMP_INTB_1 bound to source/channel/load. Preserve logs. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs, then exact-match each record separately; capture all three applicable Web rows and passive power/load/redundancy/thermal context. Apply only approved scaling and limits. Do not execute the source's literal `and`/`0~1` expression, aggregate members, probe live current paths, alter load/power/thresholds, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: All three applicable paths appear exactly once with correct electrical ownership and fresh SPEC-valid scaled values/states/thresholds in all five views, with no overcurrent, power or thermal anomaly.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires independent evidence for all three members, signed path/scaling/limit data, documented load and complete views. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/stale member, wrong path/scaling, mismatch, exceeded approved load-dependent limit or power/thermal fault. Unspecified member applicability or limits is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive telemetry only; no live current probing, load alteration, power transition or threshold write.
Protect credentials and retain complete raw inventories before exact selection.
Stop on ambiguous electrical path/scaling, overcurrent, power fault, mismatch, missing/duplicate/stale data or thermal alarm.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first load and electrical state.
expected_evidence: Three-row source/channel/load map and versioned scaling/limit/crosswalk specification
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list outputs with exits/hashes
Separate exact-match and complete Web evidence for all applicable members
Per-member normalized comparison plus power/load/redundancy/thermal/SEL context
Ambiguous-source-expression and numbering audit, no-probe/no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong path, access failure, ambiguous scaling, mismatch, overcurrent or power/thermal fault, stop passive collection and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not probe, change load/power/thresholds, clear logs or retry; escalate the exact sensor and source/channel/load path.

source_conflict.reason: Separate exact matching of the three source-named members removes ambiguous `and`/tilde execution while preserving coverage; electrical interpretation comes from a signed path map.

blocked.reason: The three identities, passive method, evidence, safety and recovery are defined; path maps and limits are Project Configuration.
